import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot for Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep, colored by Gender
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='Gender', 
                                style='BMI Category', palette='deep', alpha=0.7, s=100)

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender and BMI Category', fontsize=16)

plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 scale)', fontsize=14)
